fields.Intro Paragraph 1: You don't taste water, water tastes you. Could water be the sensory organ of God? Isabel Friend, hydrologist and president of the American Water Trust, reveals water as a living, conscious being.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Isabel Friend, water advocate, researcher, and educator, joins InnerVerse to explore water as a conscious living being. The conversation covers Viktor Schauberger's naturalist hydrology, water as the sensory organ of God with 440,000 senses per memory cell, the body being 99.95% water molecules, dark fluid theory and hydrogen as 99% of the universe, the proton as a black hole and water's transdimensional communication, water as the mediator between the physical and divine in every holy water tradition, water's memory of past and future through hydromancy, the transition from the Age of Pisces to the Age of Aquarius, the life cycle of water from spring birth to evaporation, the six steps of ennobling water, the miracle healing springs of Lourdes and beyond, and hydrogen devices like the Aqua Cure.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Water Words Hidden In The Names Of Gods", "body": "Chance opens the members half with a sampler of water buried inside the names of gods, Mercury the universal solvent carrying mer, Bacchus from bach meaning stream, Apollo beside the Sanskrit apas, Odin and Wotan sitting right on top of water, and the Euphrates read as the good water fire. Isabel answers with the Phoenician mem for water joined to ori for light, so that memory is literally light stored in water, and with Mnemosyne, goddess of water and mother of the nine Muses, so that to remember is to bring the waters forth again."}, {"title": "Every Creation Story Begins With Water", "body": "Isabel says she has never found a creation story that does not begin with water, and sorts the indigenous ones into two families, fresh water meeting salt water, or light meeting water. She points to the chemist Stanley Miller generating de novo life from a supersaturated saline solution called sole once light passed through it, and to Yule Brown, namesake of Brown's gas, concluding that the sun is water rather than fire. Our sun itself came from the Orion cloud complex, a nebula holding enough water to fill the Earth's oceans ten million times."}, {"title": "Water As The Conveyor Of Light", "body": "Coherence is what lets water store a full spectrum of light frequencies, the palette it paints with, and Isabel cites the Analemma company operating the laboratory of Nobel laureate Fritz Albert Popp to study water's biophotonic capacity. Most drinking water is drilled prematurely from a borehole and stores only truck heat and fluorescent store light. Against that she sets the Balinese high priests, who once a year gather spring water in uncovered barrels that may not pass under a bridge or even foliage, and the analemma wand, whose masculine and feminine waters are matured a full year."}, {"title": "Scripture As A Map Of The Spinal Waters", "body": "Isabel reads scripture as hydrology, from the two heys in the name Yahweh standing for the waters above and below, to water appearing 722 times in the Bible, more often than love, prayer or worship. She recommends Ched Myers and his watershed discipleship, then maps the book onto cerebrospinal fluid, one molecule away from seawater, vortexing through three chambers like ida, pingala and sushumna. The chrism oil descends to the solar plexus, is impregnated by the solar seed, climbs back through thirty three vertebrae to the choroid plexus, waits, and is resurrected as melatonin upgraded into DMT."}, {"title": "The Ocean We Are Born From", "body": "The Kogi of Colombia, Isabel says, understand water as the holographic matrix of reality, every raindrop carrying the map to existence, born of Aluna, the oceanic great mother. She then shows amniotic fluid holding the exact mineral ratios of the Cambrian ocean, the moment vertebrates first carried the sea inland as bloodstream, and notes babies developing gill slit structures in the womb. Chance hears the birth as a flood, baby and placenta as Noah and the ark, and wonders if the placenta is a guardian angel. Isabel ends on brain ventricles shaped like a ram."}]
